description: Search the web and read the top results in one call: a vendor-neutral list of URLs, titles and snippets, with each result page as concise markdown. Use when you have a question or topic but no URL yet; for one known URL use alterlab_scrape. Cost: $0.001 per query; only fetched result pages are billed on top, and scrape_results=false returns the result list alone (cheapest). Each result has a content_status (ok, partial, blocked, timeout, dead_origin, pending). concise=false returns full-length content; mode trades latency for coverage; domain restricts to one site and time_range filters by recency. When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns.

concise.description: With scrape_results=true: concise agent output, markdown with size caps. Default: true. false returns full-length content.

extraction_schema.description: JSON schema for structured extraction. Fields matching this schema are extracted from the page. Example: { "title": "string", "price": "number" }. LLM extraction needs your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one the request is rejected with byok_key_required and not charged.

mode.description: Latency tier for page content: fast (5 s), standard (15 s), deep (60 s). Default: standard.

num_results.description: Number of results to return. Default: 10.

scrape_results.description: Return the content of each result page (billed per fetched page). Default: true. false returns the unified result list only.

tag.description: Optional spend-attribution tag (lowercase letters, digits, _ . -; max 64 chars; up to 20 active tags per organization). Usage and spend are reported per tag, and a tag with a max_spend_usd budget stops accepting new work with 402 tag_budget_exhausted once the cap is reached.

name: alterlab_search
title: Search the Web
